baseline.start_from: pinned pretrained model; not Hiligaynon-adapted checkpoint

pilot_data_gate.splits: frozen; recording, audio and known speaker disjoint

execution.next: curate eligible manifest, run readiness on host, export, encode/reconstruct, stage 1 smoke, stage 2 baseline and held-out evaluation, streaming latency, native listening, stage 3 GRPO arms

encode.reference_conditioning: same_speaker_other_clip_same_split; used only by the reference-conditioned experiment

judges.placement_note: measured 2026-11-15: on the GB10, Whisper takes 0.25 s per clip (autoregressive) and Omnilingual 0.023 s (CTC), so only Whisper moves to reth5et's RTX 3070, in BF16 with batches of 8. Free VRAM there is ~5.9 GiB after stopping its nyo-tts and nyo-asr-fw engines (torch.cuda.mem_get_info over-reports under WSL2; nvidia-smi is authoritative), too tight for Whisper plus Omnilingual. MMS (FP32, as validated) and Omnilingual stay on the GB10. Real recordings and speaker embeddings never leave the GB10.
judges.fallback: if a judge fails to load, worst-judge CER is taken over the remaining families and every report names the judges that scored it

stage1.source: training/fil_moss/README.md execution step 4 and the Hiligaynon GB10 pilot (hiligaynon_tts/moss/README.md)

stage2.source: training/fil_moss/README.md execution steps 5-6; optimiser and schedule from the Hiligaynon GB10 pilot
stage2.conditioning_note: none = the pilot's unconditioned baseline; reference = the separate same-speaker reference-conditioned experiment
stage2.batch_size_note: 1 is the pilot's measured configuration. GB10 benchmark 2026-11-15: 0.75 s/step at batch 1, 0.77 s at 4, 1.28 s at 8 (peak 20-24 GiB), so batch 4 is ~3.9x the throughput; it also means 4x fewer updates, so set it deliberately
stage2.selection: lowest equally weighted mean of per-domain validation losses

stage3.source: GRPO on the stage 2 MOSS baseline; arms and reward design adopted into the MOSS plan 2026-11-15
stage3.requires: completed stage 2 report whose selected checkpoint is finetuned; same codes; keeps stage 2's conditioning
stage3.reward_weights_note: engineering choice; ranks within each group, so no term needs a hand-set scale
stage3.speaker_note: voice = anchor (similarity to the stage 2 checkpoint's own voice) for an unconditioned stage 2, conditioning-clip similarity for a reference-conditioned one
stage3.kill_note: all relative to the arm's own step-0 evaluation of the stage 2 checkpoint
